abstract: The susceptibility of trophoblastic diseases is not associated with HLA antigens. Compatibility studies between the patient and her husband, and the patient and the tumour suggest that it may not play an important role in the susceptibility or the progression of the tumour. This as well as other direct evidence indicate that the tumour cells probably do not express much HLA antigens on their cell surface. The expression of HLA antigens on normal and abnormal trophoblasts are discussed.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の易感受性はHLA抗原と関連しない。患者と夫、および患者と腫瘍との適合性試験は、HLAが易感受性や腫瘍進展に重要な役割を果たさない可能性を示唆する。その他の直接的な証拠も、腫瘍細胞は表面にHLA抗原をあまり発現していないことを示している。正常および異常な栄養膜細胞におけるHLA抗原発現についても考察する。
